aspect: No date, or a date that moves
description: A referral without a date cannot be planned around - work, childcare and travel all stay provisional for months.
energy_note: Unable to book anything, including your own life.

aspect: Deteriorating while you wait is normal
description: A joint, a cataract or a hernia gets worse on the list, so the wait itself changes the outcome and the recovery.

aspect: The private option is a price, not a choice
description: Going private is available to whoever can find the money, which converts a medical queue into a financial one.
energy_note: Rationed by queue, then rationed by price.

description: Therapy is offered after an eleven-week wait, capped at six sessions. It helps. It ends. The next referral restarts the eleven weeks.
